questions: Does every member pay the same fixed amount each round, or can each person pay any amount they like? If it is fixed, what is the amount?
Can a member pay more than once in the same round? And can a round be collected before every member has paid, or must everyone pay first?
Do rounds have to go in order, so round 2 cannot start until round 1 is collected, or can several rounds be open at once?
answers: No fixed amount. Each member can pay any amount they like, as long as it is more than zero with at most 2 decimal places, and members do not have to pay the same amount.
Yes, a member can pay more than once in the same round, and all of it counts. A round can be collected once it has some money in it, so it does not have to wait until everyone has paid.
